verdict:
REJECT AS AN ENTRY TODAY — but a PRICE-GATED WATCH at size zero, NOT a permanent kill (blue PARTIALLY OVERTURNED red, 7/10; the kill stands on ONE leg instead of eight).

THE ONE LEG THAT SURVIVES IS THE RIGHT ONE, and it settles the question this court was convened on. I asked whether expedition's 'expansion absorbed at full fare' transfers to mainstream cruise. IT DOES NOT: NCLH's FORWARD BOOK HAS DETERIORATED MONOTONICALLY FOR THREE QUARTERS in the issuer's OWN AUDITED LIABILITY — advance ticket sales, which is the audited counterpart of the booking telemetry we scraped for Lindblad. Management then cut its own year by 15% OF EBITDA IN FIVE MONTHS while its nearest comp RAISED. Where Lindblad shows zero fare cuts and 59.6% sold out, NCLH is a FULL-OCCUPANCY, PRICE-BROKEN operator. Same industry family, opposite reading — and the structural reason is the one the thesis predicted: contracted shipyard supply lands whether or not demand is there, while expedition supply is opportunistic.

AND WE HAVE NO EDGE: 'no estimate of ours that differs from the street's for the operative period'. Under §DIVERGENCE-NOT-COVERAGE that is the correct kill — we agree with the street, so there is nothing to be paid for.

RED'S SOLVENCY CASE IS WRONG AND MUST NOT BE CARRIED FORWARD: capex is PRE-FINANCED and the equity is a levered stub on a RECOVERABLE asset base. That is why the disposition is a watch with a price, not a kill — and why red's $8-10 band is superseded by $13, where the no-recovery $20 case is +50% and the recovery case +140%.

CONNECTOR DEFECT DISCLOSED AND FIXED: the bench reported expedition_inventory returning BYTE-IDENTICAL output for ncl.com and rssc.com — 1,986 departures, which is LINDBLAD'S number. The connector defaulted to LIND on any unrecognised request, so a bench asking about Norwegian received Lindblad's book as if it were NCL's. Real-looking numbers for the wrong issuer, strictly worse than a crash. Fixed this session (no default; unknown or missing operator now fails loudly) and the smoke test gained an assertion that an empty request must never return success.
reopen_gates: NONE, size zero. BOTH gates required: (i) advance ticket sales POSITIVE YoY PER CAPACITY DAY at the Q3 10-Q (~2026-11-04) — the single sufficient statistic; and (ii) price <=$13. Re-court automatically on either. CROWDED means any eventual entry is TRANCHED, never sized on an information claim.
adjudicator_note: Both courts disclosed connector defects that were reproduced and FIXED this session; MTN ran WITHOUT its snowpack read (5 dispatches, 0 observations) and the verdict should be read accordingly.
